_comment: INOX Wind 99 MW (33 x 3.0 MW WTG), Khavda - project configuration. Read by the data builder (dash_data.py) and published to the page as DATA.cfg. Never put API tokens here - the token is VL_TOKEN_INOX (fallback the "inox" entry of VL_TOKENS_JSON); see vl_token.py. The schedule is KP's wind MSP template; its procurement steps use NTPC's vocabulary (PRF raising, Floating of RFP, PO placement, GRN at Site), so the template's step defaults apply.
title: INOX Wind 99MW — MIS Dashboard (Live)
name: INOX Wind 99MW

calendar._comment: day 1 = earliest planned start in VisiLean (28-Jan-2026; the schedule runs to 31-Mar-2027). Of 3,351 activities none starts on a Saturday and 559 start on a Sunday, so Saturday is the weekly off (checked 07-Oct-2026).

departments._comment: Level 1 of the WBS -> dashboard department. Land & Liaisoning (128 activities) is land, not Project Initiation; Procurement & Vendor Documents splits on Level 3 (Level 1 here is the project itself) - Service Procurement (602) is services, Supply Procurement and the OEM WTG supply are supply. The other Level 1s (Project Initiation, Design & Engineering, Execution & Construction, Testing & Commissioning, HOTO) match the built-in rules.

_baselineMode_comment: VisiLean holds no baseline dates for this project (0 of 3,351 activities, checked 07-Oct-2026). 'planned' = the VisiLean planned dates ARE the baseline and rows are not flagged un-baselined. Switch to 'visilean' once the team sets a baseline.
_steps_comment: poStep, grnStep and rfpStep use the template defaults (poplacement, grnatsite, floatingofrfp), which match INOX's names. The service packages evaluate both bids in one step ('Technical & commercial bid evaluation'), so tbeStep names that too.
_procStage_comment: the template's NTPC stages plus the names only INOX uses: the OEM WTG chain (PRF for WTG component, PQ / SO confirmation, Dispatch clearance, Intercarting, Receipt & unloading, GRN after delivery) and 'Manufacturing / vendor preparation'.
_statSteps_comment: the chips are NTPC's milestones; INOX has a COD declaration step under Testing & Commissioning, and its statutory clearance is GEDA's, not CEA's.
_area_comment: areas would be turbine locations as on Talaja, but INOX's location field carries none yet (every activity reads Off-site / Office on 07-Oct-2026); the pattern is kept so they appear once the site fills it in.
